# Calendar

> A month to pick a date from: its name between two arrows, the days of the week, and six weeks of CalendarDays. The arrow keys move a day or a week.

## Install

It lands in `src/rost/calendar/`, with what it needs and its contract. In an app that uses shadcn:

```sh
npx shadcn add https://rost.build/r/calendar.json
```

Then import `src/rost/fonts.css` and `src/rost/tokens.css` once, at the root of the app. More on this in [Install](../INSTALL.md).

## Anatomy

- `root`: The header, then the grid, 8px apart. As wide as seven days.
- `header`: The month's name between two tertiary IconButtons: chevron-left and chevron-right.
- `title`: The month and year, in paragraph type, medium weight, the main text colour. It names the grid.
- `grid`: `role="grid"`: seven 40px columns. Its rows are `display: contents`, so the days line up in one grid.
- `row`: A week, or the days of the week: `role="row"`, laid out by the grid.
- `weekday`: A day of the week, two letters, in label type and the tertiary grey, centred, with 8px under.
- `cell`: `role="gridcell"` around each CalendarDay, laid out by the grid.

## When to use

- **Picking a day.** An invoice's date, the day a payment came in. Put it in a **Popover** under a date field, or on the page when choosing the date is the task.

## When not to use

- **A date someone knows by heart.** A birthday or a year far away is quicker to type. That's an **Input**.
- **A range.** From and to isn't done yet. Two Calendars, one for each end, for now.

## Behaviour

It shows six weeks, always, so it doesn't change height between months. The arrows change the month. In the grid, the arrow keys move a day or a week, Home and End to the week's ends, Page Up and Page Down a month, and Enter or Space picks. Moving past the month's edge turns the page. It calls `onValueChange` with the picked date and `onMonthChange` when the month changes.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: A grid (`role="grid"`) named by the month's title, with a header row of `columnheader`s whose names are the days in full. Only one day is in the tab order: the picked one, or today, or the first.
- **Name**: The month and year. Each day's button says its whole date.
- **Colour**: The title is 17:1 and the days of the week 7:1 on the dark page.

## Content

Let the locale name the month and the days. Monday first unless the people using it count from Sunday.
